notes:
CRM notes:
- SMB inbound (self-serve) — marketing campaign in 6 weeks. wants hosted_api only for now.
- Did quick stress test against free creds, observed frequent 429s and inconsistent Retry-After headers. Team alarmed.
- Primary ask: safe burst handling & clear quotas (per-key concurrency, burst window, token quota reset) + guidance for POC.
- Traffic profile: baseline 15-30 rps, planned burst 800-1200 rps for ~2 min during promos; concurrency spikes are short but frequent on campaign days.
- Cost sensitivity: "keep token/unit cost predictable; want a burst buffer without huge price uplift".
- Preferred behaviors: graceful degradation (queueing or partial responses), automatic fallback to a cheaper model variant during sustained high load, clear 429 headers (Retry-After, remaining, limit).
- Wants pre-warm or warm-up guidance (can we pre-warm to avoid cold OOMs?). Also asked whether Redwood exposes per-route quotas and per-key throttles in console (they want per-route limiting for checkout chat vs marketing bot).
- Security: SMB, will require SSO (Google) for admin console access, and audit logs for a later procurement step. Not heavy on data residency.
- Quote from CPO on call: "If we get 429s during the campaign, we'll turn the feature off — need reliability plan."
- Suggested next steps on-call: share "Burst handling / 429 best practices" doc, sample retry/backoff code, and propose 1-week POC (simulate campaign) with temporary burst increase.
- Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive), spike traffic CSV (drive), initial Fireflies transcript ff_20260301_eb12, gmail thread thread-CA12345-pebble-20260302.
- Jira ticket opened for backend: INF-3412 (request: clarify rate-limit headers & expose per-key concurrency in console).
- Notes style: shorthand, action items, internal shadow follow-ups (AE to confirm POC budget), SE to prepare spike-runbook.
customer_constraints: public cloud only; no on-prem or VPC now; limited security needs but wants SSO + audit logs; cannot accept outage during promotional windows.
technical_requirements: Need per-api-key concurrency limits, per-route quotas, explicit Retry-After header on 429s, burst window config (ability to scale short-term bursts to ~1k rps), fallback model routing, telemetry for rate-limit events (webhook/email), client-side retry guidance.
poi_notes: AE notes: friendly founders, product-led; CPO technical and time-boxed on budget. prioritizes predictable economics over bleeding-edge model quality. Short sales cycle if POC succeeds.
